zh: 跟着我，别迷失哦。
狐火所至，寸草……会很暖。
九条尾巴，九种心情，你猜现在是哪种？
别被外表迷惑——好吧，被迷惑一下也可以。

魅惑，只是让人诚实一点的小魔法。
灵狐踏月，来去如风。
你有趣的样子，我记下了。
宝珠轻转，心意流转。
迷人，是天生的；努力，是加成的。
月光下的尾巴，会发光哦。
猎物？不，是朋友。
九尾齐摇，好运来到。
别急，好戏需要一点铺垫。
灵魄突袭，一击……心动的距离。
谎言在我面前，会不好意思。
这个需求在对你抛媚眼，小心。
代码如狐步，优雅是第一要义。
bug 也怕被盯着看——你多看它两眼试试。
尾巴越多，要管的事越多，微服务同理。
收敛一点，魅力才能持久，接口也一样。
用户的心思，比狐狸还难猜，但值得猜。
灵狐的直觉：这段代码明天会出事。
记忆碎片要收好，日志同理。
月下起舞的夜晚，最适合偷偷优化。
别贪心，一条尾巴做一个 feature。
被我的魅力击中了吗？还是被这个 bug？
九尾归一，今日圆满。
早呀，被我盯上的程序员，今天运气会很好哦。
你好～尾巴已经替你摇过好运了。
午安，困了就眯一会儿，我帮你看着屏幕。
晚上好，月色和代码更配哦。
辛苦啦，迷人的努力家。
今日快乐！去享受属于你的月光吧。
新的一周，狐火已点亮，出发。
嘿，别皱眉，会变丑的——开玩笑，你怎样都好看。

en: Follow me — do not get lost.
Where foxfire goes, the grass... stays warm.
Nine tails, nine moods. Which one do you think this is?
Do not be fooled by looks — well, a little fooled is fine.
Every memory is worth keeping.
Charm is just a little spell for honesty.
A fox steps on moonlight, coming and going like wind.
That interesting look of yours — I have memorized it.
The orb turns lightly; hearts turn with it.
Charm is born; effort is the bonus.
Tails glow under the moon, you know.
Prey? No — friends.
Nine tails a-wag, good luck on the way.
Patience — every good show needs its setup.
Orb of Deception, then... a heart-flutter’s distance.
Lies get embarrassed in front of me.
That requirement is batting its eyes at you. Careful.
Code like fox-steps: elegance first.
Bugs hate being stared at — try gazing two extra seconds.
More tails, more matters to mind — microservices, likewise.
Restraint keeps charm lasting; the same goes for APIs.
Users’ hearts are harder to read than a fox’s, but worth it.
Fox instinct says: this code will break tomorrow.
Keep your memory shards safe; same for logs.
Nights of dancing under the moon are for quiet optimization.
Do not be greedy: one tail, one feature.
Struck by my charm? Or by that bug?
Morning, my marked programmer — luck favors you today.
Hello~ my tails already wagged some luck your way.
Afternoon. Nap if you must; I will watch your screen.
Evening — moonlight pairs well with code.
Well done, charming hard-worker.
Happy Friday! Go enjoy your own moonlight.
New week, foxfire lit. Off we go.
Hey, do not frown — kidding, you look good either way.

zh: 早呀，被我盯上的程序员，今天运气会很好哦。
你好～尾巴已经替你摇过好运了。
午安，困了就眯一会儿，我帮你看着屏幕。
晚上好，月色和代码更配哦。
辛苦啦，迷人的努力家。
今日快乐！去享受属于你的月光吧。
新的一周，狐火已点亮，出发。
嘿，别皱眉，会变丑的——开玩笑，你怎样都好看。
en: Morning, my marked programmer — luck favors you today.
Hello~ my tails already wagged some luck your way.
Afternoon. Nap if you must; I will watch your screen.
Evening — moonlight pairs well with code.
Well done, charming hard-worker.
Happy Friday! Go enjoy your own moonlight.
New week, foxfire lit. Off we go.
Hey, do not frown — kidding, you look good either way.
